verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains general marketing copy about Figma's design, collaboration, and prototyping features (e.g., figma-docs-14, figma-docs-15, figma-docs-27) but nothing that specifically confirms what is included in the free tier versus paid seats, nor any claim that a full editor and real-time collaboration work without payment. Pricing-related items (figma-docs-12, figma-docs-23, figma-docs-37) only describe advanced/paid capabilities like Dev Mode and MCP Server access, leaving the free-tier experience unaddressed.
